learning_outcomes.text: Explain quality management principles and the process approach
Describe the structure and intent of a quality management system
Apply risk-based thinking and document control to QMS processes
Plan and conduct a process audit against defined criteria
Report findings and drive corrective action and continual improvement

integrative_case: An internal auditor must audit a purchasing process against a quality management system: plan the audit scope and criteria, gather objective evidence, classify findings, and present nonconformities and improvement opportunities with corrective-action requirements to process owners.
